what_happened: Scene layout 8/style 8, but unlike s4/s10/s17 (same layout, where the target is the wooden open upper cabinet above the counter) the target here is the sage-green upper cabinet above the sink, door open; the robot starts facing it and the bowls are on the counter to the right of the sink, 0.86 / 0.56 m from its interior (successes: 0.45-0.49 m). Small red wooden bowl1 (bowl_9 x0.7) and larger black ribbed bowl2 (bowl_5 x0.95). Strategy: nest-then-carry, executed cleanly: after a few brief touches 174-201 it grasped the red bowl at 237/248 (lift 0.24 m), set it inside the black bowl (released 391; wrist 360-440 shows red inside black), grasped the black bowl's rim at 415/428 and lifted the nested pair 0.62 m (456-536, red still inside). It then moved the stack to the RIGHT of the green cabinet, to the wooden upper shelf/cabinet next to it (the fixture that is the target in the other layout-8 episodes), and released at 539: the stack sits there tilted (bowl1 tilt 29 deg), still nested, but 0.17 m (bowl1) and 0.21 m (bowl2) outside the target cabinet's interior box. Stage 0 never held. 560-1400 the arm wandered (wrist sees wood panelling, drawers, floor) with closes on air at 755, 775 and 1229; it never touched the bowls again.
causal_chain: target is the green cabinet over the sink, farther from the bowls than usual (0.56-0.86 m) -> nest and pair-lift done correctly (391-536) -> stack carried to the adjacent wooden upper shelf instead of into the open green cabinet, released 539 ~0.2 m outside its interior -> stage 0 never holds; policy behaves as if done and wanders -> timeout
self_recovery: none: after the release it never re-grasped the stack.
official_criterion_notes: The official result is correct (stack is outside the target cabinet). Possible scene ambiguity: layout 8 has two upper storage fixtures side by side; the policy chose the one that is the target in s4/s10/s17.
